content_text:
Ready for your next move in civil design? Build your career. Enjoy the lifestyle. Make an impact.
Join STP Consultants and work on a diverse range of civil engineering projects, contributing to innovative solutions and delivering quality outcomes across a variety of sectors.
As a Civil Designer, you’ll have the autonomy to make an impact, the support to keep developing your skills, and the opportunity to work on projects that help shape communities across Queensland - all within a down-to-earth team that values your experience, ideas and contribution.
Why you’ll love working here  
A growing team with exciting opportunities 
Be part of a supportive team where your experience, ideas and contribution are valued. As our Brisbane office expands, you'll have the opportunity to build strong professional relationships, share your knowledge and make a meaningful contribution to our continued success. 
Variety that builds your experience 
Work across residential, commercial and infrastructure projects, gaining exposure to a range of engineering challenges across Queensland. From developing technical solutions to supporting project delivery, you'll have the opportunity to apply your skills across diverse projects and continue expanding your experience. 
Take ownership of your career 
Develop your technical capabilities, take on greater responsibility and learn from experienced engineers and designers. Depending on your experience and interests, you'll have opportunities to lead projects, mentor developing professionals and strengthen your client relationships. 
A great Brisbane location 
Our Fortitude Valley office is conveniently located close to public transport, cafés and restaurants, with easy access to the CBD, New Farm and Howard Smith Wharves. Enjoy a convenient work location while being part of a team delivering quality engineering solutions. 
What’s in it for you?  
- 
Competitive remuneration: a package that reflects your experience and the value you bring.
- 
Flexibility: 9-day fortnight, flexible hours, plus the option to purchase additional leave.
- 
Professional development: CPD support plus mentoring
- 
Recognition and rewards: employee referral rewards and recognition programs that don’t feel like an afterthought.
- 
Inclusive, friendly culture: supportive colleagues, collaborative working relationships and regular social events.
- 
Wellbeing support: access to a confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) when you need it.
- 
Career growth with momentum: real ownership, real development, and room to progress.
- 
Stability & reputation: Join a respected, Australian-owned consultancy with a strong and diverse client base.
The Opportunity
As our Brisbane office continues to grow, we’re looking for an experienced Civil Designer to join our team and play a key role in delivering exciting projects across the region.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Designing earthworks, stormwater drainage and sewer systems for commercial and residential developments
- Creating conceptual and detailed civil designs using 12D Model and AutoCAD, ensuring all design documentation meets project, client and quality requirements.
- Preparing civil design drawings and documentation for Development Applications (DA) and Operational Works (Op Works) applications
- Collaborating with engineers, surveyors and external consultants to develop practical and compliant design solutions
- Conducting site inspections, including subgrade and basecourse proof rolls, sewer testing and on-maintenance inspections
- Incorporating site inspection findings into design documentation and project outcomes
- Supporting feasibility studies, reports and cost estimates
- Ensuring designs comply with relevant codes, legislation and Australian Standards
- Assisting with construction monitoring and inspections to ensure design intent is delivered on site
About you
You’ll bring solid technical capability, initiative and a collaborative approach, along with:
- 6+ years of civil design/drafting experience, preferably within a consulting environment.
- Associate Degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification
- Strong knowledge of design software including 12D Model and AutoCAD
- Knowledge of local and statutory requirements, legislation, and Australian Standards
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Full, unrestricted Australian working rights
About STP Consultants
For more than 20 years, STP Consultants has been helping shape communities across Queensland. As a privately owned, multidisciplinary consultancy, we bring together expertise in Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Hydraulic, Fire and Seismic engineering to deliver a diverse range of projects across the state.
Our values - Potential, Respect, Integrity, Deliver and Engage, guide how we work with our clients and support one another every day.
We’re proud of our approachable leaders, collaborative culture and commitment to technical excellence. At STP, you’ll work alongside experienced professionals in an environment where people are trusted to contribute, share ideas and deliver quality outcomes.
How to apply
If you're looking for a role where your experience is valued, your career can grow, and flexibility is genuinely supported, we'd love to hear from you.
Click Apply Now and join the STP Consultants team.
STP Consultants is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome applications from all backgrounds.
